json.description: JSON value, or JSON text that parses to one

html.description: HTML markup; must contain at least one tag

jsonlogic.description: JsonLogic rule, checked against the operators of the Semantius backend

reference.description: Key of a record in another entity

parent.description: Key of the record that owns this one

enum.description: One of the values listed in enum

uri.description: Absolute URI, RFC 3986; Unicode allowed as in an IRI (https://müller.de/straße); validates the same as iri

uri-reference.description: URI or relative reference, RFC 3986; Unicode allowed as in an IRI (/straße, #top); validates the same as iri-reference

iri.description: Absolute IRI, RFC 3987 (https://müller.de/straße); validates the same as uri

iri-reference.description: IRI or relative reference, RFC 3987 (/straße, #top); validates the same as uri-reference

url.description: URL with an http, https or ftp scheme

email.description: Email address, RFC 5321; Unicode allowed as in RFC 6531 (jörg@müller.de); validates the same as idn-email

idn-email.description: Internationalized email address, RFC 6531 (jörg@müller.de); validates the same as email

hostname.description: Host name, RFC 1123; Unicode allowed as in RFC 5890 (müller.de, xn--mller-kva.de); validates the same as idn-hostname

idn-hostname.description: Internationalized host name, RFC 5890 (müller.de, xn--mller-kva.de); validates the same as hostname

json-pointer-uri-fragment.description: JSON Pointer as a URI fragment (#/a/0)
